description: Docs, API reference, help center and guides for RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative: a subscription backend that works with the RevenueCat SDK.
rules: RevenueDot works with the RevenueCat SDK: set the SDK's proxy URL to https://api.revenuedot.app (RevenueDot Cloud), and keep your purchase code.

The SDKs are RevenueDot's MIT forks of RevenueCat's SDKs; imports and class names stay the same (for example `import RevenueCat` on iOS and `com.revenuecat.purchases.*` on Android). Each SDK has a guide in docs/sdks.
Start on RevenueDot Cloud: sign up at https://app.revenuedot.app/signup. Teams that must run their own server can follow docs/guides/self-hosting.md.
The REST API reference is generated from api/openapi.yaml (OpenAPI 3.1); the same API is served by Cloud and self-hosted servers.
To move an app off RevenueCat, follow docs/migrate/README.md: import, run side by side, then switch the proxy URL.
